# Bobs Drawn Mace And Trident

---

## Unique Art Style
Ever wanted your mace or trident to look like they were drawn by someone who has never seen a mace and trident before? Now they can!

Tired of those realistic texture packs? Then welcome to **Bobs Drawn Mace And Trident**, the only pack where the bad looks are the best part! This pack replaces every single pickaxe texture, drawn by **me**.
